blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Prompt-tuning has emerged as a parameter-efficient technique for adapting large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks while keeping the pre-trained weights frozen. However, prompt-tuned VLMs often suffer from a base-to-novel dual miscalibration problem, where models typically show underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes. Current VLM calibration approaches address this dual miscalibration either separately or jointly, but lack a geometric understanding of the hyperspherical embedding space and thus fail to exploit angular discriminative properties to adjust distorted decision boundaries. To address this, we propose M-PFT, a novel angular-margin approach for prompt tuning that introduces two complementary objectives to promote class discriminability and semantic anchoring. This enlarges the angular margin by 1) minimizing the maximum cosine similarity between tunable class embeddings to reduce embedding collapse and 2) minimizing the angular distance between each tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding to preserve semantic geometry. Extensive experiments across 9 prompt-tuning methods with various backbones on 15 diverse datasets show that our approach reduces the average calibration error on novel classes, while remaining competitive on base classes and maintaining comparable accuracy. Further analyses reveal that M-PFT effectively adjusts distorted decision boundaries induced by prompt tuning while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, improving calibration with negligible computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 即时调制已经成为一种参数效率高的技术,用于使大型视觉语言模型(VLMs)适应下游的任务,同时使预先训练的重量被冻结. 然而,即时调取的VLM经常会遇到从基础到小的双重校正问题,模型通常表现出对基础课的不信任和对小说课的过度自信. 目前的VLM校正方法可以分别或联合地解决这种双重校正错误,但对超球形嵌入空间缺乏几何理解,因此无法利用角分辨性来调整被扭曲的决定边界. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用M-PFT这一新的角-边距方法来迅速调整,引入两个相辅相成的目标来推动阶级歧视性和语义定位。 这扩大了角边:1)将可捕金枪鱼类嵌入物的最大同位素相似性最小化,以减少嵌入倒塌;2)将可捕金枪鱼类嵌入物与相应零发入物之间的角相距最小化,以保留语义几何. 9个快速调试方法在15个不同数据集上进行了广泛的实验,显示我们的方法减少了小说类的平均校正误差,同时保持了基础类的竞争能力并保持了可比较的准确性. 进一步的分析表明,M-PFT在保持预先训练的嵌入空间的同时,有效地调整了通过即时调取而引发的扭曲的决定界限,用可忽略不计的计算间接费用改进了校正.

blocks.en: Foundational vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP [ 36 ] and ALIGN [ 16 ] , have achieved remarkable progress in open-vocabulary image recognition by leveraging large-scale natural-language supervision. To efficiently adapt such pre-trained large VLMs to domain-specific tasks, where full fine-tuning is often computationally prohibitive, Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques have gained considerable attention [ 20 ] . Representative PEFT approaches, such as Low-Rank Adaptation [ 15 ] , inject trainable low-rank decomposition matrices into transformer layers based on the hypothesis that weight updates have a low intrinsic rank, while Prompt-Tuning [ 20 ] optimizes a small subset of learnable prompt tokens while keeping the backbone frozen. Recently, attention has shifted toward Test-Time Prompt-Tuning [ 40 ] , which, unlike standard prompt-tuning, requires no labeled training data and instead optimizes learnable prompt vectors via gradient descent, adapting them during inference on unlabeled test samples. In open-vocabulary settings, prompt-tuned VLMs can substantially improve performance on base classes while preserving the model’s inherent capability to generalize to novel classes [ 17 , 51 ] . Such low-cost adaptation is particularly valuable in safety-critical applications such as healthcare and autonomous systems, where full fine-tuning is often infeasible [ 49 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 基础视觉语言模型(VLMs),如CLIP[36]和ALIGN[16],通过利用大规模自然语言监督,在开放-vobulary图像识别方面取得了显著进展. 为了有效地使这种预先训练的大型VLM适应特定领域的任务,即完全的微调往往在计算上令人望而却步,Pameret-Effective Fine-Tuning(PEFT)技术获得了相当的注意[20]. 代表性的PEFT方法,如Low-Rank Refect [15],基于重量更新内在排名较低这一假设,将可训练的低级分解矩阵注入变压器层,而即时-图宁[20]则在保持骨干冻结的同时,优化了一小段可学习的即时符号. 最近,注意力转向了测试-时间即时调试[40],这与标准即时调试不同,不需要贴标签的培训数据,而是通过梯度降级优化可学习的即时向量,在对无标签测试样本进行推论时对其进行调整。 在开放的省道设置中,即时调试的VLM可以大幅度提高基础课的性能,同时保留模型内在的通向小说类的能力[17,51]. 这种低成本的适应在诸如卫生保健和自主系统等安全关键应用中特别宝贵,在这些应用中,全面微调往往不可行[49,8]。

blocks.en: However, existing few-shot prompt-tuning techniques [ 52 , 51 , 46 , 17 , 23 , 53 , 18 , 50 , 11 ] for VLMs primarily focus on improving classification accuracy while often overlooking reliable confidence calibration, i.e., the degree to which a model’s predicted confidence reflects the true likelihood of correctness [ 10 , 42 ] , which is evaluated with Expected Calibration Error (ECE). For example, prompt-tuned VLMs exhibit base-to-novel dual miscalibration, which typically shows underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes [ 44 , 39 ] . When deployed in safety-critical applications, this dual miscalibration is harmful in two ways: overconfidence often results in models assigning high confidence to incorrect predictions, leading to inappropriate automation or missed human review, while underconfidence assigns low confidence to correct predictions, which is associated with uncertain or unreliable confidence estimates undermining triage, wasting expert time, and eroding trust [ 26 , 32 , 5 , 54 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,用于VLM的现有几发即时调试技术[52,51,46,17,23,53,18,50,11]主要侧重于提高分类精度,同时往往忽略可靠的置信度校准,即一个模型的预测置信度在多大程度上反映了正确性的真实可能性[10,42],该校准误差以预期校准误差(ECE)来评价. 例如,即时调制的VLMs展出基础对小行星的双重校准,这通常显示出对基础课的不信任和对小说课的过度自信[44,39]. 当部署在安全关键应用中时,这种双重误判在两个方面是有害的:过度自信往往导致模型给不正确的预测以高度信心,导致不适当的自动化或错失人检,而不信任则给正确的预测以低信心,这与不确定或不可靠的信任估计相关联,破坏分解,浪费专家时间,并侵蚀信任[26,32,5,54,3].

blocks.en: To maintain well-calibrated confidence estimates across both base and novel classes, some progress has been made toward addressing dual miscalibration. In light of this, prior works such as DAC [ 45 ] scale the temperature based on the textual deviation (TD) score between embeddings of each novel class. CAC [ 24 ] adjusts logits based on image-text alignment, while DOR [ 44 ] samples textual outliers that do not overlap with base classes. Another approach [ 29 ] normalizes logits and constrains them to the original zero-shot VLM distribution by modifying the softmax expression with margin penalization. TCPT [ 39 ] introduces an auxiliary regularization loss to stabilize decision boundaries with a mean-variance margin while preserving semantic dispersion by aligning the first and second moments of text embeddings. Despite these advances, we observe that these statistical approaches fail to adequately exploit the angular discriminative properties of the hyperspherical embedding space when adjusting distorted decision boundaries, which is crucial for resolving dual miscalibration. Specifically, most methods do not impose explicit geometric constraints during prompt tuning, allowing learned embeddings to deviate from the pre-trained embedding space. We define θ j ​ k \theta_{jk} as the angle between tunable class embeddings and θ j \theta_{j} as the angle between a tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding. This can result in issues like (1) embedding collapse , where tunable class embeddings cluster together ( θ j ​ k ↓ ) \left(\theta_{jk}\downarrow\right) , reducing inter-class discriminability [ 22 ] , and (2) semantic drift , where tunable embeddings move away from their corresponding zero-shot embeddings ( θ j ↑ ) \left(\theta_{j}\uparrow\right) , distorting decision boundaries, degrading model’s ability to learn semantic relationships between class embeddings, and inducing spurious overconfident predictions on novel inputs [ 44 , 24 ] . Furthermore, auxiliary losses employed by existing methods target statistical properties rather than angular discriminative properties of class embeddings. This can introduce gradients in opposing directions that partially offset each other, limiting their ability to adjust distorted decision boundaries [ 29 , 39 ] . Consequently, these methods cannot effectively enlarge the angular margin and remain suboptimal for calibration.
blocks.zh: 为了在基础班和新式班级中保持良好的信心估计,在处理双重误差方面取得了一些进展。 有鉴于此,之前的作品如DAC[45]根据每个小说类的嵌入值之间的文字偏差(TD)分数来标定温度. CAC [24]根据图像文本对齐调整日志,而DOR [44] 样本文本输出器则不与基类重叠. 另一种方法[29]使对数正常化,并通过用比值惩罚来修改软马克斯表达式,将其限制在原来的零射VLM分布. TCPT [39] 引入了辅助规范化损失,通过调整文本嵌入的第一和第二时刻,在保持语义分散的同时,以平均变量比值稳定决定边界. 尽管取得了这些进展,但我们注意到,这些统计方法未能在调整扭曲的决定界限时,充分利用超球嵌入空间的角质差异性,这对解决双重误判至关重要。 具体来说,大多数方法在即时调试时不会施加明显的几何限制,使得所学的嵌入能够偏离预先训练的嵌入空间. 我们定义 j k\theta\jk} 以金枪鱼类嵌入物和 j\theta\j} 以金枪鱼类嵌入物和相应的零射入物之间的角度。 这可能导致如下问题:(1) 嵌入崩溃, 金枪鱼类嵌入组合( j k )\ left(\theta_{jk}\downarrow\right) , 降低阶级之间的区别性 [22] 和(2) 语义漂移, 金枪鱼类嵌入从相应的零射嵌入( j↑ )\ left(\thea_{j}\uparrow\r\right) , 扭曲决定界限, 降低模型学习类嵌入之间的语义关系的能力, 以及诱导对新投入的虚假的过度预测 [44, 24] 。 此外,现行方法采用的辅助损失针对的是统计属性,而不是类嵌入的角性区别属性。 这可以引入对立方向的梯度,部分相互抵消,限制它们调整扭曲的决定边界的能力[29,39]. 因此,这些方法无法有效扩大角差,而且仍然不能达到校准的最佳程度。

blocks.en: Inspired by these insights, we propose M-PFT , a novel angular optimization approach that introduces a simple yet effective angular-margin approach into prompt tuning. This exploits the angular discriminative properties of the hyperspherical embedding space [ 21 , 22 ] with negligible computational overhead. To address dual miscalibration, our proposed method 1) promotes class discriminability by minimizing the maximum cosine similarity between tunable class embeddings, encouraging discriminative decision boundaries, and 2) enforces semantic anchoring by minimizing the angular distance between each tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding, thereby preserving semantic geometry. As shown in Fig. 2 , these complementary objectives act synergistically to enlarge the angular margin ( θ j ​ k − θ j ) \left(\theta_{jk}-\theta_{j}\right) : ℒ min-max \mathcal{L}_{\text{min-max}} maximizes θ j ​ k \theta_{jk} , while ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} minimizes θ j \theta_{j} . This absence of conflicting gradients (see Tab. 4 and Fig. 4 ) and yields well-separated, discriminative decision boundaries while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, thereby reducing base-class underconfidence and novel-class overconfidence, as shown in Fig. 1 . blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prompt tuning of large VLMs. Early research focused on static prompts shared across all inputs (CoOp [ 52 ] ), while subsequent work introduced instance-conditioned prompts that adapt dynamically to each image input (CoCoOp [ 51 ] ). Knowledge-guided methods, such as KgCoOp [ 46 ] , regularize the learned prompt space by minimizing the distance between learned and hand-crafted textual embeddings, while gradient-aligned methods, such as ProDA [ 23 ] and ProGrad [ 53 ] , selectively update prompts whose gradients align with the zero-shot CLIP objective. Recent advances incorporated multimodal prompt learning (MaPLe [ 17 ] ), visual context modulation (PromptSRC [ 18 ] ), bidirectional knowledge flow (HiCroPL [ 50 ] ), and modality-agnostic representation spaces (MMRL [ 11 ] ).
These techniques are typically trained with few-shot supervision on a small set of base-class samples that require labeled data, and evaluated for zero-shot generalization to novel classes. This paradigm improves open-vocabulary recognition without fully fine-tuning VLMs. However, while existing methods improve classification accuracy, they often overlook calibrating predicted probabilities, leading to base-to-novel dual miscalibration and failure for reliable deployment.
blocks.zh:
快速调试大型VLM. 早期的研究侧重于所有投入共享的静态提示(CoOp [52]),而随后的工作引入了以实例为条件的提示,以动态方式适应每个图像输入(CoCoOp [51] ). KgCoOp [46] 等知识引导方法,通过最小化学习到的和手工制作的文字嵌入之间的距离来规范所学的快速空间,而梯度对齐的方法,如ProDA [23] 和ProGrad [53],有选择地更新其梯度与零镜头CLIP目标一致的提示. 最近的进展包括多式联运即时学习(MaPLe [17]),视觉上下文调制(PromptSRC [18]),双向知识流动(HiCroPL [50]),以及模式不可知的表示空间(MMRL [11])。
这些技术通常经过培训,对一小组需要贴标签数据的基级样品进行几发监督,并被评价为零发一般化为新颖类. 这个范式改进了开放-vobulary识别,而没有完全微调VLM. 然而,虽然现有方法提高了分类的准确性,但往往忽略了对预测概率的校准,导致基准对新星双重校准错误和可靠部署失败.

blocks.en: Calibration of deep neural networks. Traditional post-hoc techniques, such as Temperature Scaling [ 10 ] , Platt Scaling [ 35 ] , and Histogram Binning [ 30 ] , adjust confidence estimates after training by modifying logits on a held-out validation set. While effective for in-distribution data, these methods often struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios because they rely on labeled target-domain data. In contrast, train-time methods incorporate auxiliary losses during training to penalize miscalibrated predictions, including label smoothing [ 28 ] , focal loss [ 27 ] , and margin-based calibration [ 29 ] . Although these approaches improve reliable uncertainty estimates, they typically require fully labeled datasets and full fine-tuning, making them impractical for PEFT techniques such as prompt tuning in few-shot settings.
blocks.zh: 深层神经网络校准. 传统的热后技术,如温度放大[10]、Platt放大[35]和直方图平宁[30],在培训后通过修改停机验证集的日志来调整信心估计数。 这些方法虽然对分布内数据有效,但往往会因为依赖于标注的目标域数据而难以概括到分布外情景. 相比之下,列车时间方法包含在训练期间的辅助损失,以惩罚误判的预测,包括标签平滑[28],焦损失[27],和以差值为基础的校准[29]. 虽然这些方法改进了可靠的不确定性估计,但它们通常需要完全贴上标签的数据集和完全的微调,使其对PEFT技术不切实际,如在几发环境中迅速调试。

blocks.en:
Calibration for prompt-tuned VLMs. DAC [ 45 ] employs post-hoc temperature scaling guided by semantic distances between class embeddings, but may compromise the sharp decision boundaries of pre-trained models [ 39 ] . [ 29 ] introduced zero-shot normalization and sample-adaptive logit scaling to realign prompt-tuned models with zero-shot CLIP by adjusting expanded logit distributions. Other efforts focus on VLM calibration for test-time prompt tuning: C-TPT [ 47 ] maximizes average textual feature dispersion, A-TPT [ 1 ] promotes angular diversity, and AGI-TPT [ 2 ] enforces attainable geometric separation for uniformity. MVC-Bench [ 38 ] evaluates medical imaging calibration and stabilizes decision boundaries with a mean-variance margin, though these approaches introduce additional inference-time overhead.
These collective studies highlight the importance of class discriminability for reducing base-class underconfidence, preserving the zero-shot CLIP embedding geometry for better novel-class calibration, and the limitations of post-hoc corrections in restoring pre-trained calibration properties. Our proposed method exploits the angular discriminative properties of the embedding space during training to address the observed base-to-novel dual miscalibration pattern without sacrificing discriminative strength.

快速调试VLM的校准. DAC [45] 采用了以类嵌入之间的语义距离为引导的热后温度缩放,但可能会损害预先训练的模型的锐度决定边界[39]. [29] 引入了零射常态和采样调试的对数缩放,通过调整扩大的对数分布来以零射CLIP调整快速调试模型. 其他努力侧重于测试时间快速调试的VLM校准:C-TPT [47] 将平均文字特征分散最大化,A-TPT [1] 促进角多样性,AGI-TPT [2] 执行可实现的几何分离,以求统一. MVC-Bench [38] 评估医学成像校准,并以平均变量比值稳定决定边界,尽管这些方法引入了额外的推算时间间接费用.
这些集体研究突出了阶级歧视对于降低基础阶级的不自信,保留零镜头的CLIP嵌入几何以更好地进行新颖阶级校准的重要性,以及在恢复事先训练的校准属性时的后修的局限性. 我们提议的方法利用训练期间嵌入空间的角性差异性,解决观察到的基对新星双校准模式,同时不牺牲歧视力量.

blocks.en: Prompt tuning of fine-tuned VLMs. While zero-shot classification with handcrafted templates is widely adopted, it often requires domain-specific heuristics and may not be optimal across a variety of tasks. To address this, prompt tuning optimizes learnable prompt tokens to adapt VLMs to domain-specific tasks. Instead of relying on hand-crafted prompt templates, a set of learnable context tokens 𝒯 p = 𝚕 1 , … , 𝚕 M \mathcal{T}_{p}={{\tt l}_{1},\ldots,{\tt l}_{M}} , where M M is the context length, is introduced as a prefix to the class name. For class c k ∈ 𝒞 c_{k}\in\mathcal{C} , the prompt is defined as 𝚙 k = [ 𝚕 1 , … , 𝚕 M , 𝚎 k ] {\tt p}_{k}=[{\tt l}_{1},\ldots,{\tt l}_{M},{\tt e}_{k}] , where 𝚎 k {\tt e}_{k} is the static class-name embedding. The text encoder maps it into a class representation ϕ k = f t ​ ( 𝚙 k ) \mathbf{\phi}_{k}=f_{t}({\tt p}_{k}) . Given image x x , the cosine similarity for class c k c_{k} is computed as s k = sim ​ ( f i ​ ( x ) , ϕ k ) s_{k}=\text{sim}(f_{i}(x),\mathbf{\phi}_{k}) , and class probabilities are obtained via softmax as in zero-shot inference. The prompt tokens 𝒯 p \mathcal{T}_{p} are optimized using a small labeled training set 𝒟 = { ( x j , y j ) } j = 1 ℬ \mathcal{D}=\{(x_{j},y_{j})\}_{j=1}^{\mathcal{B}} , typically by minimizing cross-entropy loss over predicted class probabilities. During prompt tuning, the model is trained only on the base classes in a few-shot setting, denoted as 𝒞 base ⊂ 𝒞 \mathcal{C}_{\text{base}}\subset\mathcal{C} , and evaluated on remaining base class samples and novel classes encountered at test time as 𝒞 novel = 𝒞 ∖ 𝒞 base \mathcal{C}_{\text{novel}}=\mathcal{C}\setminus\mathcal{C}_{\text{base}} . In this section, we first analyze the base-to-novel dual miscalibration problem in prompt-tuned VLMs and then present our training-time method to address it.

Dual miscalibration analyses. To examine the calibration behavior of prompt-tuned VLMs, we conduct a systematic analysis across multiple prompt configurations and datasets. As shown in Fig. 3 , reliability diagrams and cosine similarity analyses reveal a dual miscalibration pattern indexed by the angular margin θ j ​ k − θ j \theta_{jk}-\theta_{j} . For base classes, reliability plots show underconfidence: predicted probabilities lag behind actual accuracy, reflecting reduced θ j ​ k \theta_{jk} between tunable class embeddings. Fig. 3 (upper right), lower cosine similarity corresponds to lower calibration error, where maximizing θ j ​ k \theta_{jk} enlarges the angular margin for better calibration, showing a negative correlation between angular margin and underconfidence. For novel classes, the opposite pattern emerges: predictions are overconfident, assigning high predicted probabilities to incorrect classes, which is exacerbated when tunable embeddings drift from their corresponding zero-shot embeddings ( θ j ↑ ) \left(\theta_{j}\uparrow\right) , distorting decision boundaries at test-time. Fig. 3 (lower right), higher cosine similarity is associated with lower ECE, where minimizing θ j \theta_{j} enlarges the angular margin for better calibration, which shows a negative correlation between angular margin and overconfidence. The scatter plot in Fig. 3 (right) quantifies these trends and reveals a negative correlation between angular margin and ECE. Although cross-dataset correlation for the base class is weak, further analyses in Tab. 4 show that increased θ j ​ k \theta_{jk} reduces base ECE to 2.49, supporting the correlation.
These findings show that prompt tuning distorts the well-calibrated decision boundaries of zero-shot CLIP. A well-calibrated open-vocabulary VLM should enlarge the angular margin while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, where increasing θ j ​ k \theta_{jk} reduces base-class underconfidence, while decreasing θ j \theta_{j} suppresses novel-class overconfidence. This motivates our angular-margin approach to prevent embedding collapse and preserve semantic geometry.

blocks.en: The primary objective of M-PFT is to improve confidence calibration for prompt-tuned discriminative VLMs, such as CLIP, with reliable confidence estimates for base-to-novel dual miscalibration. As shown in Fig. 2 , this miscalibration arises because prompt tuning distorts the decision boundaries of the pre-trained embedding space, making them asymmetric and poorly separated. Specifically, base classes suffer from embedding collapse ( θ j ​ k ↓ ) \left(\theta_{jk}\downarrow\right) , leading to underconfidence, while novel classes suffer from semantic drift ( θ j ↑ ) \left(\theta_{j}\uparrow\right) , causing overconfidence. Unlike existing calibration approaches [ 29 , 45 ] , which fail to exploit the angular discriminative properties of the hyperspherical embedding space. Our method addresses this dual miscalibration with two complementary objectives that enlarge the angular margin by 1) class discriminability , which promotes discriminative decision boundaries, and 2) semantic anchoring , which preserves the semantic geometry of the pre-trained embedding space.

For a predicted class c j c_{j} and runner-up class c k c_{k} , the log-ratio of their probabilities is given by log ⁡ ( p j / p k ) = τ ​ v ⊤ ​ ( ϕ j − ϕ k ) \log(p_{j}/p_{k})=\tau v^{\top}(\mathbf{\phi}_{j}-\mathbf{\phi}_{k}) . Since ‖ ϕ j − ϕ k ‖ = 2 ​ sin ⁡ ( θ j ​ k / 2 ) \|{}\mathbf{\phi}_{j}-\mathbf{\phi}_{k}\|{}=2\sin(\theta_{jk}/2) , applying the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality yields | log ⁡ ( p j / p k ) | ≤ 2 ​ τ ​ sin ⁡ ( θ j ​ k / 2 ) |{}\log(p_{j}/p_{k})|{}\leq 2\tau\sin(\theta_{jk}/2) . We use this bound to motivate our approach: when inter-class embedding collapse drives θ j ​ k → 0 \theta_{jk}\to 0 , it shrinks the maximum attainable margin between the top-1 and runner-up classes. This caps the top-1 confidence regardless of sample separability, causing base underconfidence. Well-separated class embeddings yield discriminative decision boundaries, reducing base-class underconfidence. Therefore, we propose min-max regularization to promote class discriminability
by maximizing angular distance between tunable class text embeddings. Since cosine similarity and angular distance are monotonically inversely related on the unit sphere, we implement this
by minimizing the cosine similarity between class embeddings. We then compute 𝑺 = 𝚽 ^ ​ 𝚽 ^ T ∈ ℝ N × N \bm{S}=\mathbf{\hat{\Phi}}\mathbf{\hat{\Phi}}^{T}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N} ,

Training objective. To address dual miscalibration, we combine the two regularization terms described in above
with standard cross-entropy. Here, ℒ min-max \mathcal{L}_{\text{min-max}} promotes discriminability, while ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} preserves the semantic geometry of the pre-trained embedding space. blocks.en: Complementary objective. ℒ min-max \mathcal{L}_{\text{min-max}} maximizes θ j ​ k \theta_{jk} by pushing tunable class embeddings apart to enforce class discriminability and reduce base-class underconfidence, while ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} minimizes θ j \theta_{j} by anchoring each tunable embedding close to its zero-shot counterpart to preserve semantic geometry and suppress novel-class overconfident predictions. ℒ min-max \mathcal{L}_{\text{min-max}} alone can drift the tunable embeddings from their corresponding zero-shot embeddings, shrinking the angular margin and amplifying novel-class overconfidence, while ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} alone leaves θ j ​ k \theta_{jk} unconstrained, failing to address base-class underconfidence. This dual design of M-PFT with gradient blocking creates two complementary objectives that act synergistically to enlarge the angular margin and yield well-separated, discriminative boundaries without sacrificing discriminative strength (see Fig. 4 and Tab. 4 ).

blocks.en: Calibration performance on base classes. As shown in Tab. 1 , M-PFT reduces base-class miscalibration across backbones while preserving accuracy. Averaged across 10 10 datasets, M-PFT lower ECE from 4.54 4.54 to 3.85 3.85 on CLIP and from 2.75 2.75 to 2.54 2.54 on SigLIP, while maintaining or slightly improving accuracy. The gains are larger for the cross-entropy baseline highly miscalibrated: for CoOp on CLIP, ECE reduces from 6.82 6.82 to 2.94 2.94 , while raising accuracy from 81.54 81.54 to 82.97 82.97 . For already well-calibrated methods such as MMRL, calibration remains stable ( 1.60 1.60 ECE). Compared to competitive TCPT, M-PFT achieves the lowest average ECE on SigLIP ( 2.63 CLOSE (2.63 to OPEN 2.54 ) 2.54) . M-PFT trails TCPT on base-class ECE with CLIP backbones while retaining higher accuracy on CLIP. These results show that enforcing class discriminability mitigates embedding collapse and resulting base-class underconfidence.

blocks.en: Calibration performance on novel classes. We evaluate M-PFT on novel classes under open-vocabulary generalization using CLIP and SigLIP backbones. While prompt tuning improves zero-shot accuracy (74.30 Acc., 4.43 ECE on CLIP), it degrades calibration for overconfident methods such as CoOp (12.63 ECE) and ProDA (9.03 ECE). M-PFT significantly improves these miscalibrated methods, reducing ECE for CoOp to 4.75, ProDA to 3.99, and MaPLe from 6.18 to 4.08 while boosting accuracy. Well-calibrated methods like MMRL remain stable (3.72 to 3.47 ECE). We attribute this to anchoring tunable embeddings to the pre-trained geometry, which locally corrects semantic drift. In contrast, post-hoc DAC only rescales confidence, partially aiding MaPLe (6.18 to 4.86 ECE) but overcorrecting MMRL (3.72 to 4.95 ECE). Overall, M-PFT achieves the lowest average ECE (3.86) and highest accuracy (75.32) on CLIP, outperforming the baseline (5.98), DAC (4.70), and TCPT (4.21). This trend holds on SigLIP, where M-PFT yields the lowest ECE (3.69) compared to the baseline (4.31) and TCPT (4.30) at a comparable accuracy (81.08), proving that semantic anchoring suppresses novel-class overconfidence without sacrificing generalization.

blocks.en: Anchor-based methods. Prior anchor-based methods like KgCoOp, ProGrad, and PromptSRC apply distance, alignment, or consistency to improve generalization to novel classes without connecting angular geometry to the base-to-novel calibration trade-off. We link angular geometry: inter-class embedding collapse θ j ​ k → 0 \theta_{jk}\rightarrow 0 shrinks top-1 and runner-up class margins ( p j → p k p_{j}\rightarrow p_{k} ), capping base confidence, while semantic drift θ j ↑ \theta_{j}\uparrow inflates margins to spike novel confidence. As shown in Tab. 5, on average across these three methods, M-PFT reduces CLIP base ECE from 5.26 to 4.85 at 81.43 accuracy and novel ECE from 4.33 to 3.66 at 74.72 accuracy. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose M-PFT, a novel method for calibrated prompt tuning of fine-tuned VLMs that introduces two regularizers: (1) min-max regularization to improve class discriminability and (2) anchoring regularization to preserve the semantic geometry of the pre-trained embedding space. Compared with current methods, M-PFT promotes class discriminability θ j ​ k ↑ \theta_{jk}\uparrow while reducing semantic drift θ j ↓ \theta_{j}\downarrow , thereby effectively enlarging the angular margin. This dual design with gradient blocking creates two complementary objectives that act synergistically to exploit the angular discriminative properties of the hyperspherical embedding space without distorting decision boundaries. Extensive experiments across 9 prompt-tuning techniques and 15 datasets demonstrate that M-PFT improves the calibration of prompt-tuned VLMs, particularly on novel classes, without compromising classification accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出M-PFT,这是一种新颖的方法,用于校准微调VLM的即时调值,它引入了两种常态器:(1)分母规范化,以提高阶级区别性;(2)锚定规范化,以保留预训嵌入空间的语义几何. 与目前的方法相比,M-PFT促进阶级区别性 j k \theta jk oparrow,同时减少语义漂移 j \theta j}\ downarrow,从而有效扩大角边. 这种带有梯度阻断的双重设计产生了两个互补的目标,它们协同发挥作用,利用超球形嵌入空间的角差异性,而不扭曲决策界限。 9种即时调试技术和15种数据集的广泛实验表明,M-PFT改进了即时调试的VLM的校准工作,特别是在新颖类上,同时不影响分类准确性.

blocks.en: Evaluation setup. We follow the standard open-vocabulary setting, and the datasets are divided into disjoint base and novel classes. blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate the proposed approach along with comparison calibration methods on 15 datasets spanning various image classification tasks. These tasks include object recognition on ImageNet [ 7 ] and Caltech 101 101 [ 9 ] datasets, fine-grained object recognition such as Oxford Pets [ 33 ] , Food 101 101 [ 4 ] , Stanford Cars [ 19 ] , Oxford Flowers 102 102 [ 31 ] , and FGVCAircraft [ 25 ] datasets. Following the base-to-new generalization protocol introduced by CoCoOp [ 51 ] , downstream datasets are partitioned into disjoint base and novel class subsets. As detailed in Tab. 1 , each dataset is divided into training and test splits. The fine-tuned CLIP model is prompt-tuned solely on the base classes. Then the model is tested on both class subsets and unseen categories.

blocks.en: Calibration performance on base classes (CLIP). As shown in Tab. 3 , M-PFT consistently achieves superior calibration performance (lower ECE) while maintaining competitive accuracy across all evaluated prompt learning methods and datasets. For CoOp, M-PFT reduces the average ECE from 6.82 6.82 (Baseline) to 2.94 2.94 , surpassing TCPT’s 2.98 2.98 while improving accuracy from 81.54 81.54 to 82.97 82.97 . In methods like CoCoOp and KgCoOp, M-PFT remains competitive with TCPT while consistently outperforming the Baseline, and for MaPLe, it achieves an average ECE of 2.80 2.80 without sacrificing accuracy 82.38 82.38 . M-PFT also shows strong cross-method compatibility, achieving the best ECE for HiCroPL 3.16 3.16 and the most significant aggregate gain with MMRL, lowering the average ECE to 2.50 2.50 compared to 3.24 3.24 for TCPT. At the dataset level, on Flowers102 within PromptSRC, M-PFT achieves an ECE of 3.10 3.10 against the baseline’s 5.15 5.15 , and on OxfordPets within MMRL, it reaches an accuracy of 95.82 95.82 , confirming that calibration gains do not come at the cost of accuracy. These results validate the generalizability of M-PFT in mitigating base-class underconfidence across diverse prompt-tuning techniques and datasets.
blocks.zh: 基础课的校准性能(CLIP). 如塔布所示. 3, M-PFT一贯实现优异的校准性能(低于欧洲经委会),同时保持所有被评价的快速学习方法和数据集的竞争性准确性。 对于CoOp, M-PFT 减少 欧洲经委会的平均比率从6.826.82(基准线)增至2.942.94,超过了TCPT的2.982.98,同时提高了准确度,从81.54 81.54提高到82.97 82.97。 在CoCoOp和KgCoOp等方法中,M-PFT与TCPT保持竞争力,同时一贯优于基线,对MaPLe来说,它在不牺牲准确性的情况下,平均实现2.80 2.80的ECE。 M-PFT还显示出很强的跨方法兼容性,实现了HiCroPL 3.16 3.16的最佳ECE和MMRL最显著的总收益,将ECE的平均比TCPT的3.24 3.24降低到2.50 2.50。 在数据集一级,在Flowers102 in SuperSRC上,M-PFT的ECE比基线的5.155.15达到3.103.10,在MMRL范围内的OxfordPets上,它达到了95.82.95.82的精度,证实校准收益不以准确性为代价。 这些结果证实了M-PFT在通过各种快速调试技术和数据集来减轻基础水平的不信任方面的总体性。

blocks.en: Calibration performance on novel classes (CLIP). We further evaluate the robustness and efficacy of M-PFT on novel classes, summarized in Tab. 4 . Consistent with the trends observed on base classes, M-PFT maintains a superior balance between accuracy and ECE on unseen categories. For CoOp, M-PFT substantially reduces the average ECE from 12.63 12.63 (Baseline) to 4.75 4.75 , surpassing both DAC ( 7.13 7.13 ) and TCPT ( 5.06 5.06 ), with accuracy improving from 69.25 69.25 to 72.68 72.68 . For MaPLe, M-PFT yields a marked improvement on EuroSAT, lowering ECE from 11.68 11.68 (Baseline) to 5.23 5.23 while nearly matching the Baseline’s accuracy. While ProDA achieves a notable accuracy gain on EuroSAT ( 51.86 51.86 to 74.64 74.64 ), its overall average ECE ( 3.99 3.99 ) trails several other methods, with MMRL achieving the lowest average ECE among all settings at 3.47 3.47 . HiCroPL attains the best overall average accuracy ( 77.81 77.81 ) among the compared methods, closely followed by PromptSRC at 76.18 76.18 . Crucially, these calibration gains do not come at the expense of discriminative strength, as M-PFT maintains high accuracy levels such as 97.84 97.84 on OxfordPets within ProGrad and 93.52 93.52 on Caltech101 within ProDA. These results confirm that M-PFT remains reliable and well-calibrated even when encountering novel, out-of-distribution classes.
blocks.zh: 小说班上的校准表演(CLIP). 我们进一步评价了塔布所总结的M-PFT在小说课上的稳健性和有效性. 4. 根据在基本类别方面观察到的趋势,M-PFT在准确性和欧洲经委会在无形类别方面保持较好的平衡。 对于CoOp,M-PFT大幅减少 欧洲经委会的平均比率从12.63 12.63(基准)增至4.75 4.75,超过了发援会(7.13 7.13)和TCPT(5.06 5.06),准确度从69.25 69.25提高到72.68 72.68。 对马普雷公司来说,M-PFT对EuroSAT有显著改善,将欧洲经委会从11.68(基准)降至5.23(5.23),同时几乎与基线的准确性相符。 虽然ProDA在EuroSAT上取得了显著的精度增益(51.86-54.64 74.64),但其总体平均数为欧洲经委会(3.99 3.99),是其他几种方法,其中MMRL在所有环境下的平均精度最低,为3.47 3.47。 在比较方法中,HiCroPL达到最佳总平均准确度(77.81 77.81),紧随其后的是SourceSRC76.18 76.18。 关键的是,这些校准收益并不以歧视强度为代价,因为M-PFT保持高精度水平,如ProGrad内部的牛津Pets上97.84 97.84,ProDA内部的Caltech101上93.52. 这些结果证实,M-PFT即使在遇到新颖的,不分发的班级时,仍然可靠,而且校准良好.

blocks.en: Calibration performance on base classes (SigLIP). To assess whether the dataset-wise calibration gains of M-PFT extend beyond the CLIP backbone, we report the full dataset-wise breakdown using SigLIP in Tab. 5 . M-PFT achieves lower or comparable ECE relative to both the Baseline and TCPT across most prompt-tuning methods, while accuracy remains largely on par with both. For CoOp, M-PFT’s average ECE rises slightly from 2.54 (Baseline) to 2.79, though a dataset-wise improvement is still visible on Caltech101 (1.25 to 1.01). For KgCoOp, M-PFT reduces ECE on Aircraft from 5.84 to 4.46 while accuracy is essentially preserved. The most pronounced aggregate improvement is observed with MaPLe, where M-PFT lowers the average ECE from 2.56 (Baseline) to 1.95 while simultaneously achieving the highest accuracy among the three settings at 86.31. These results confirm that M-PFT’s class-discriminability objective continues to mitigate base-class underconfidence across most prompt-tuning methods under a different vision-language backbone, such as SigLIP.
blocks.zh: 基础班的校准性能(SigLIP). 为了评估M-PFT的数据集校准收益是否超出CLIP主干线,我们使用Tab中的SigLIP报告全数据集的细分. 5. M-PFT与基线和TCPT相比,在大多数快速调整方法上都取得了较低或可比的欧洲经委会成果,而准确性与两者基本相同。 对CoOp来说,M-PFT的平均ECE从2.54(Baseline)略微上升至2.79,尽管在Caltech101(1.25至1.01)上仍然可以看到数据集的改进。 对于KgCoop,M-PFT将飞机上的ECE从5.84减少到4.46,而精度则基本保留下来. 在MaPLe中观察到了最显著的总体改善,M-PFT将平均欧洲经委会从2.56(碱性)降至1.95,同时在三个设置中达到86.31的最高准确度。 这些结果证实,M-PFT的阶级差别性目标继续在SigLIP等不同视觉语言主干线下,减轻大多数快速调整方法的基础阶级信心不足。

blocks.en: Calibration performance on novel classes (SigLIP). We further evaluate the generalization capability of M-PFT to novel classes under the SigLIP backbone, with the complete dataset-wise results presented in Tab. 6 . Consistent with the trends observed on the CLIP backbone, M-PFT achieves the lowest or near-lowest average ECE across nearly all evaluated methods, while improving or maintaining accuracy relative to the Baseline, DAC, and TCPT. For CoOp, M-PFT substantially reduces the average ECE from 6.94 (Baseline) to 4.87, surpassing TCPT 7.35, with accuracy improving from 76.16 to 78.61. For MaPLe, M-PFT yields a marked improvement on EuroSAT, lowering ECE from 14.52 to 9.09 while raising accuracy from 57.51 to 69.65, the largest single-dataset accuracy gain observed in the novel-class setting. PromptSRC achieves the best overall average accuracy of 83.64 among the compared methods, while M-PFT remains competitive with EuroSAT in cross-modal methods such as HiCroPL and MMRL despite the dataset’s inherently high variance. These results demonstrate that M-PFT’s semantic-anchoring objective continues to suppress novel-class overconfidence at the dataset-wise level under the SigLIP backbone, reinforcing that the dual miscalibration problem and its mitigation generalize beyond CLIP.
blocks.zh: 小说班的校准表演(SigLIP). 我们进一步评估了M-PFT在SigLIP主干下向新类的普及能力,在Tab中介绍了完整的数据集结果。 6. 与CLIP主干线上观察到的趋势相一致,M-PFT在几乎所有评价方法中都实现了欧洲经委会最低或近最低的平均数,同时相对于基线、发援会和TCPT而言,提高或保持准确性。 对于CoOp,M-PFT将平均欧洲经委会从6.94(碱性)减少到4.87,超过TCPT 7.35,准确性从76.16提高到78.61。 对MaPLe来说,M-PFT对EuroSAT有显著的改进,将ECE从14.52降至9.09,同时将精确度从57.51提高到69.65,这是在新类设定中观察到的最大单数据集精度增益. 快速SRC在比较方法中达到83.64的最佳总体平均精度,而M-PFT在HiCroPL和MMRL等跨模式方法中仍然与EuroSAT具有竞争力,尽管数据集固有的高度差异。 这些结果表明,M-PFT的语义定理目标继续在SigLIP主干线下压制新颖阶层在数据集层面的过度自信,强化了双重校准问题及其缓解范围超越CLIP的范围。

blocks.en: Appendix C Calibration performance under natural distribution shifts
blocks.zh: 附录C 自然分布变化下的校准性能

blocks.en: We evaluate the robustness of M-PFT under natural distribution shifts across four out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets, representing diverse challenges: natural images (ImageNet-V2) [ 37 ] , black and white sketches (ImageNet-S) [ 43 ] , natural adversarial examples (ImageNet-A), [ 14 ] , and artistic renditions (ImageNet-R) [ 13 ] . As shown in Tab. 7 , we compare M-PFT against Zero-Shot, Baseline, DAC, and TCPT across both base and novel classes.
blocks.zh: 我们评价M-PFT在自然分布变化下在四个分布外(OO)数据集中的稳健性,这代表着不同的挑战:自然图像(ImageNet-V2)[37],黑白素描(ImageNet-S)[43],自然对抗性实例(ImageNet-A)[14],艺术引渡(ImageNet-R)[13]. 如塔布所示. 7,我们比较了M-PFT和Zero-Shot, Basin, DAC,以及TCPT, 无论是基础类还是新颖类.

blocks.en: Calibration performance on base classes. As shown in Tab. 7 , M-PFT consistently surpasses both the Baseline and TCPT under natural distribution shifts. M-PFT achieves the best overall calibration with an average ECE of 2.03 2.03 , a significant reduction compared to Zero-Shot 3.92 3.92 , Baseline 3.00 3.00 and TCPT 2.73 2.73 . These improvements are particularly pronounced on challenging shifts; for instance, M-PFT reduces ECE from 3.14 3.14 to 1.52 1.52 on ImageNet-V2, from 3.94 3.94 to 2.02 2.02 on ImageNet-S, and from 3.14 3.14 to 2.13 2.13 on ImageNet-R. Importantly, these gains are achieved while maintaining competitive accuracy, with M-PFT simultaneously lowering ECE and improving accuracy over the Baseline on ImageNet-S and ImageNet-R, reaching accuracies of 58.77 58.77 and 86.06 86.06 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 基础课的校准性能. 如塔布所示. 7,M-PFT在自然分布变化下持续超过基线和TCPT. M-PFT达到最佳整体校准,平均ECE为2.032.03,与零射线3.923.92、基线3.003.00和TCPT2.732.73相比大幅减少。 例如,M-PFT将欧洲经委会从ImageNet-V2上的3.143.14减至1.521.52,将ImageNet-S上的3.943.94减至2.022.02,将ImageNet-R上的3.143.14减至2.132.13。 重要的是,这些收益是在保持竞争性准确性的同时取得的,M-PFT同时降低欧洲经委会的水平,提高ImageNet-S和ImageNet-R基线的准确性,分别达到58.77 58.77和86.06 86.06。

blocks.en: Calibration performance on novel classes. The generalization capability of M-PFT is further validated on novel classes. M-PFT reduces ECE from 3.16 3.16 to 1.52 1.52 on ImageNet-V2, from 3.73 3.73 to 2.05 2.05 on ImageNet-S, and from 3.14 3.14 to 2.13 2.13 on ImageNet-R. Consistent with the base-class trends, M-PFT maintains superior performance under distribution shift, achieving the lowest average ECE 1.95 1.95 and outperforming both the Baseline 2.90 2.90 and TCPT 2.55 2.55 . The consistent performance across both base and novel classes indicates that M-PFT addresses the fundamental dual miscalibration problem rather than overfitting to dataset-specific artifacts, which is critical for real-world deployment where models must provide reliable confidence estimates even when encountering data that differs from the training distribution.
blocks.zh: 小说课上的校准表演. M-PFT的普及能力在小说课上得到了进一步的验证. M-PFT在ImageNet-V2上将欧洲经委会从3.16 3.16减少到1.52 1.52,在ImageNet-S上从3.73 3.73减少到2.05 2.05,在ImageNet-R上从3.14 3.14减少到2.13 2.13。 根据基数趋势,M-PFT在分配转移下保持优异业绩,实现了欧洲经委会1.951.95的最低平均业绩,比基线2.90 2.90和TCPT 2.55 2.55都好。 基础班和新颖班的一贯表现表明,M-PFT解决了基本的双重校准问题,而不是过于适合特定数据集的文物,这对于实际世界的部署至关重要,即使遇到与培训分配不同的数据,模型也必须提供可靠的信任估计。

blocks.en: Appendix D Other calibration metrics: MCE and ACE
blocks.zh: 附录D 其他校准指标:MCE和ACE

blocks.en: To provide a more comprehensive evaluation of model calibration beyond the Expected Calibration Error (ECE) discussed in our main paper, we evaluate M-PFT using two additional metrics: Maximum Calibration Error (MCE) and Adaptive Calibration Error (ACE), both computed with the SigLIP backbone. These metrics offer a deeper look into the reliability of predicted probabilities, with MCE highlighting worst-case scenarios and ACE providing a more robust measure across varying data densities.
blocks.zh: 为了对超出我们主要文件中讨论的预期校准误差(欧洲经委会)的模型校准进行更全面的评价,我们利用两个额外的衡量标准对M-PFT进行评价:最大校准误差(MCE)和适应性校准误差(ACE),两者都用SigLIP主干线计算。 这些衡量标准更深入地研究了预测概率的可靠性,其中MCE强调了最坏情况,ACE提供了针对不同数据密度的更强有力的衡量标准。

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 8 , our approach improves calibration performance across most of the 10 10 fine-grained classification datasets compared to prompt-tuning techniques on base classes, when using the SigLIP backbone. Our method significantly refines MaPLe’s calibration, with the average MCE dropping from 0.78 0.78 to 0.63 0.63 and the average ACE dropping from 2.47 2.47 to 1.81 1.81 . These shifts indicate a substantial decrease in both average and peak miscalibration. Similar trends were observed with PromptSRC, where M-PFT lowers the average MCE from 0.68 0.68 to 0.64 0.64 and the average ACE from 2.02 2.02 to 1.82 1.82 . For MMRL, M-PFT achieves an average MCE comparable to the baseline ( 0.48 ​ vs. ​ 0.50 ) \left(0.48~\text{vs.}~0.50\right) while reducing the average ACE from ( 1.54 ​ to ​ 1.46 ) \left(1.54~\text{to}~1.46\right) . The notable improvements in MCE for MaPLe and PromptSRC are particularly vital. Since MCE identifies the maximum gap between confidence and accuracy, these results suggest that M-PFT effectively mitigates extreme overconfidence, leading to more dependable model outputs even in the most challenging classification cases. Overall, these findings reinforce the versatility and effectiveness of M-PFT in producing well-calibrated models across diverse prompt-learning techniques, even when paired with a different vision-language backbone such as SigLIP.
blocks.zh: 如Tab.8所示,在使用SigLIP主干线时,我们的方法提高了10个精细分类数据集中大多数数据集的校准性能,而基类的快速调试技术则有所改进。 我们的方法大大改进了马普莱的校准,平均MCE从0.78 0.78下降到0.63 0.63,平均ACE从2.47 2.47下降到1.81 1.81。 这些变化表明平均和峰值的校准都大幅减少。 在SourceSRC中也观察到了类似的趋势,M-PFT将平均MCE从0.68 0.68降至0.64 0.64,平均ACE从2.02.02降至1.82 1.82。 对于MMRL,M-PFT实现平均MCE与基线相当(0.48对0.50)\左(0.48~\text{vs.}~0.50\右),同时将平均ACE从(1.54到1.46)\左(1.54~\text{to}~1.46\右). 对马普雷和迅速SRC的教育和教育的显著改进特别重要。 由于MCE确定了信心和准确度之间的最大差距,这些结果表明M-PFT有效缓解了极端的过度自信,导致即使在最具挑战性的分类案例中,模型输出更可靠. 总体而言,这些结论强化了M-PFT在制作各种快速学习技术的精准模型方面的多功能性和有效性,即使与SigLIP等不同的视觉语言主干网结合。

blocks.en: Analysis of the novel class performance, shown in Tab. 9 , largely mirrors the trends observed in the base classes, reinforcing the generalization capability of M-PFT. For MaPLe, M-PFT reduces the average MCE from 1.58 1.58 to 1.26 1.26 and the average ACE from 4.56 4.56 to 3.44 3.44 , again indicating a marked reduction in both peak and average miscalibration. For PromptSRC, M-PFT lowers the average MCE from 1.05 1.05 to 0.85 0.85 and the average ACE from 3.49 3.49 to 3.11 3.11 . For MMRL, M-PFT yields a more modest effect: the average ACE improves slightly from 3.61 3.61 to 3.45 3.45 , while the average MCE remains comparable to the baseline ( 1.22 ​ vs. ​ 1.27 ) \left(1.22~\text{vs.}~1.27\right) . This stability across diverse metrics, including ECE, MCE, and ACE, indicates that our method resolves underlying miscalibration rather than merely overfitting to a single error type. By successfully mitigating both worst-case and peak calibration errors across most settings, the proposed method demonstrates the reliability required for deployment in safety-critical applications, regardless of the underlying vision-language backbone.

blocks.en: Fig. 1 illustrates how ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} interacts directly with ℒ CE \mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}} on both base and novel classes in the absence of ℒ min-max \mathcal{L}_{\text{min-max}} . Applied in isolation, ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} marginally reduces underconfidence on base classes by preserving the pre-trained semantic geometry of CLIP without enforcing class discriminability. Nevertheless, it effectively suppresses overconfidence on novel classes by anchoring tunable embeddings to their corresponding zero-shot embeddings, thereby maintaining the relative class structure of the pre-trained embedding space and preventing semantic drift ( θ j ↑ ) (\theta_{j}\uparrow) . As shown in Fig. 1 , incorporating ℒ min-max \mathcal{L}_{\text{min-max}} alongside ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} further reduces the dual miscalibration problem on both base and novel classes by simultaneously enforcing class discriminability ( θ j ​ k ↑ ) (\theta_{jk}\uparrow) and preserving the pre-trained semantic geometry. Together, these two complementary objectives address the geometric root causes of the dual miscalibration problem, embedding collapse and semantic drift , yielding well-separated, adjusted decision boundaries that consistently reduce underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes.

blocks.en: The addition of ℒ min-max \mathcal{L}_{\text{min-max}} to the cross-entropy baseline consistently improves base class calibration. For instance, on OxfordPets, ECE drops from 2.68 2.68 to 1.68 1.68 , and on Caltech101, it significantly decreases from 1.54 1.54 to 0.67 0.67 . While this confirms improved discriminability for base classes, novel-class ECE often remains high or increases (e.g., from 2.21 2.21 to 5.45 5.45 on SUN397), highlighting overconfidence in novel classes. Integrating ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} is pivotal for novel class performance. On SUN397, novel ECE drastically improves from 5.45 5.45 to 1.02 1.02 (w/o gradient blocking). Similarly, EuroSAT shows a reduction in novel ECE from 9.30 9.30 to 4.92 4.92 . These results validate that anchoring zero-shot embeddings prevents the distortion typically caused by unconstrained angular maximization. The inclusion of gradient blocking yields the most stable results across both categories. In the DTD base class, ECE improves from 3.12 3.12 to 2.14 2.14 when gradient blocked. Crucially, it prevents the collapse of class discriminability, on Aircraft, the full M-PFT objective maintains a competitive novel ECE of 8.70 8.70 , whereas baseline cross-entropy suffers at 11.61 11.61 . Across all individual datasets, the full M-PFT objective (with gradient blocking) achieves the most robust calibration-accuracy trade-off, demonstrating that the synergy between ℒ min-max \mathcal{L}_{\text{min-max}} and ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} is a consistent requirement regardless of the specific data domain.

blocks.en: Appendix F Impact of hyperparameters
blocks.zh: 附录F 超参数的影响

blocks.en:
For M-PFT, we introduce two regularization coefficients: λ 1 \lambda_{1} for min-max regularization ( ℒ min-mx \mathcal{L}_{\text{min-mx}} ) and λ 2 \lambda_{2} for zero-shot anchoring regularization ( ℒ anchor \mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}} ). To determine their optimal values, we perform a sensitivity analysis by sweeping each coefficient independently while holding the other fixed.
As shown in Tab. 14 , we evaluate the impact of these parameters on model accuracy and Expected Calibration Error (ECE), averaged across the Food101, Caltech, and Oxford Flowers datasets. We observe that setting λ 1 = 0.4 \lambda_{1}=0.4 and λ 2 = 1.4 \lambda_{2}=1.4 yields a superior balance between base/novel class accuracy and calibration performance (achieving an average Accuracy of 94.64 94.64 and a low average ECE of 1.48 1.48 ). To ensure a consistent and fair evaluation setting, these heuristically determined values are held fixed across all datasets and prompt-tuning backbones. All reported results are averaged over three random seeds.

blocks.en: To assess the generalizability and adaptability of the M-PFT, we evaluate calibration performance when applied to CoOp across two different backbones: ResNet-50 and ViT-B/32. As shown in Tab. 11 and Tab. 12 , M-PFT demonstrates robust performance across varying backbones, effectively reducing calibration error while maintaining accuracy.
blocks.zh: 为了评估M-PFT的通用性和适应性,我们通过两个不同的骨干网(ResNet-50)和ViT-B/32. 如表11和表12所示,M-PFT显示不同骨干之间表现强劲,在保持准确性的同时有效减少校准误差。

blocks.en: On the ResNet-50 backbone, M-PFT achieves a significant reduction in ECE, reaching an average of 3.78, compared to the 4.04 reported for the baseline. This trend remains consistent for the ViT-B/32 backbone, where M-PFT attains an average ECE of 2.98, notably outperforming the baseline’s 3.15. These results indicate that M-PFT consistently improves the reliability of model predictions.
blocks.zh: 在ResNet-50主干线上,M-PFT实现了欧洲经委会的大幅削减,平均达到3.78,而基数为4.04。 这一趋势在Vit-B/32主干线上保持不变,M-PFT平均达到2.98的欧洲经委会,特别是超过了基线的3.15。 这些结果表明,M-PFT不断提高模型预测的可靠性.

blocks.en: M-PFT also exhibits strong competitive performance in zero-shot scenarios for novel classes. In ResNet-50, M-PFT achieved the lowest average ECE, down from 9.38 to 4.96, compared to TCPT at 5.46. In ViT-B/32, M-PFT lowers ECE from 10.13 to 4.70, compared to TCPT 5.82. Overall, these findings suggest that M-PFT provides a versatile solution for model calibration that scales effectively across different model backbones without sacrificing discriminative power.
blocks.zh: M-PFT在小说类的零镜头场景中也表现出强烈的竞争表现. 在ResNet-50中,M-PFT实现了欧洲经委会最低平均水平,从9.38降至4.96,而TCPT为5.46。 在Vit-B/32中,M-PFT将欧洲经委会从10.13降至4.70,而TCPT 5.82。 总的来说,这些调查结果表明,M-PFT为模型校准提供了一个多功能的解决方案,在不牺牲歧视性力量的情况下,有效跨越不同的模型骨干。

blocks.en:
To assess the overhead of M-PFT, we compared per-batch computation time, GPU memory usage, and ECE against MaPLe [ 17 ] on FGVC Aircraft [ 25 ] (16-shot, ViT-B/16) using PyTorch [ 34 ] .
M-PFT’s average per-batch training time is 0.057 0.057 s versus 0.055 0.055 s for the MaPLe Baseline, an increase of under 2 2 ms, and GPU memory usage remains virtually unchanged, while ECE decreases from 4.77 4.77 to 3.76 3.76 .
These results confirm that M-PFT improves calibration with negligible computational overhead.
blocks.zh:

M-PFT的每批培训平均时间为0.057 0.057秒,而MaPLe基线为0.055 0.055秒,增加不到2米,GPU的内存使用几乎没有变化,欧洲经委会则从4.77 4.77降至3.76 3.76。

blocks.en: Tab. 15 presents the standard deviation of accuracy and Expected Calibration Error (ECE) over three random runs with different seeds for M-PFT across 10 10 datasets for base and novel classes with MMRL [ 11 ] as the backbone. Compared to the Baseline, M-PFT generally exhibits a lower average standard deviation across both metrics. Specifically, for Base classes, M-PFT achieves an average standard deviation of 0.26 0.26 for ECE (compared to 0.29 0.29 for Baseline) and a competitive 0.35 0.35 for Accuracy. In the Novel class setting, M-PFT shows a marked improvement in stability, reducing the average standard deviation of ECE to 0.42 0.42 from the Baseline’s 0.47 0.47 . These results indicate more stable performance with respect to randomness in prompt initialization and greater consistency in calibration. This consistency highlights M-PFT’s reliability in maintaining stable performance across runs, a critical property for practical deployment in scenarios that demand reproducibility and calibration stability.
